metadata.title: Cooky: what do I cook today?
metadata.description: Your recipe box, your kitchen and the weather, together. Cooky helps you decide what to cook, plan the week, shop once and cook with friends.

home.headline: What do I cook today?
home.tagline: Plan, cook, and shop without the guesswork.

decide.title: Decide in seconds
decide.body: Cooky ranks your own dishes by what's already in your kitchen, the season and today's weather.

plan.title: Plan, shop, cook
plan.body: Plan the week, host guests, get one merged shopping list and cook step by step with timers.

share.title: Cook with friends
share.body: Share recipes with the people you choose, chat, and see what they loved.

notFound.title: This page isn't on the menu
notFound.description: The link may be old or mistyped. Go back home to keep cooking.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong on our side
errorPage.description: Nothing you did caused this, and your data is safe. Try again, or go back home.

errors.forbidden: You don't have access to this.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find that. It may have been removed.
errors.invalid: Some details need fixing. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.rate_limited: That was a lot at once. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.quota_exceeded: You've used all your tries for this period.
errors.conflict: This changed somewhere else. Reload to see the latest version.
errors.unavailable: This isn't available right now. Try again in a moment.

emails.footer: You're receiving this because this address was used on Cooky.
emails.linkFallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email for Cooky
verifyEmail.preview: Confirm your email to start cooking with Cooky.
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.body: Tap the button to confirm this is your email address. Then you can log in.
verifyEmail.ignore: Didn't sign up for Cooky? You can ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your Cooky password
resetPassword.preview: Choose a new password for Cooky.
resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: We got a request to reset your password. Tap the button to choose a new one.
resetPassword.expiry: This link works for 1 hour and only once.
resetPassword.ignore: Didn't ask for this? Ignore this email and your password stays the same.

auth.nameHint: Friends see this when you share recipes.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Don't reuse a password from another site.
auth.compromised: This password appeared in a data breach, so it isn't safe. Choose a different one.
auth.consent: I agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

signUp.title: Create your Cooky account
signUp.subtitle: Your recipes, your kitchen, your week. Free to start.
signUp.checkEmailBody: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your address and you'll be signed in.
signUp.checkEmailHint: Nothing after a few minutes? Look in spam, or send the link again.
signUp.resent: A new link is on its way.

logIn.title: Log in to Cooky
logIn.subtitle: Welcome back. Your kitchen is waiting.
logIn.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match. Check both and try again.
logIn.verifyEmail: Confirm your email first. We just sent a new link to {email}.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account's email. We'll send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account uses {email}, a reset link is on its way. It works for 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Pick something you don't use anywhere else.
reset.doneBody: Log in with your new password. For your safety, every device was signed out.
reset.invalidBody: Reset links work for 1 hour and only once. Ask for a new one.

verified.title: Email confirmed
verified.body: Your account is ready and you're signed in.
verified.errorBody: Confirmation links work for 24 hours. Enter your email to get a new one.
verified.sentBody: If {email} still needs confirming, a new link is on its way. It works for 24 hours.

legal.draftNotice: Draft summary. The full legal text is published before Cooky launches; this version is the one recorded when you sign up.

points.account: You're responsible for your account and for keeping your password private.
points.content: Recipes and notes you add stay yours. You let Cooky store and show them to the people you choose.
points.fairUse: Don't misuse Cooky: no spam, abuse, or attempts to break or overload the service.
points.plans: Paid plans renew until you cancel. Cancelling keeps your plan until the period ends.
points.changes: If these terms change materially, we'll tell you before the new version applies.

points.collect: We keep only what Cooky needs: your account, your recipes and plans, and settings you choose.
points.never: We never sell your data and never show other people your email address.
points.processors: Trusted providers run parts of Cooky for us, such as hosting, email and payments. They act only on our instructions.
points.rights: You can export everything or delete your account at any time from Settings.
points.cookies: We use only the cookies Cooky needs to keep you signed in. No advertising trackers.

validation.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
validation.emailTooLong: That email address is too long.
validation.acceptTermsRequired: Agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy to continue.
